We also offer

• Knowledge of satellite systems, launch services, or space data platforms is a plus.
• Knowledge of Python programming language.
• Solid understanding of electronics design and operation.
• Familiarity with manufacturing processes desirable.
• Experience with documentation tools, simulation software, or mission planning tools, as well as collaborative platforms (JIRA).

Our culture is fast-paced and growth-oriented - a place where your work will have a real impact, and where you can truly leave your mark.

• 25 days of paid vacation, plus additional compulsory paid days off

• FitFabrik Fitness Center
